text: だまって　はいって　しつれいな　こどもだ！

structure.jp: だまって　はいって
しつれいな　こどもだ！

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.span: だまって　はいって
patterns.explanation: A て-form before another verb can tell you in what way the second action is done. だまって　はいって = 'coming in without a word'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: はいって　しつれいな
patterns.explanation: A て-form can give the reason for the feeling or judgment that follows. はいって　しつれいな　こどもだ = 'coming in like that, what a rude child'.
